title: Two cosmic neighborhoods
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: The Milky Way contains the Sun and its Solar System along with many other stars and planetary systems. A galaxy is a much larger structure than one solar system.

misconception: A learner may choose: The Solar System
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Which is the larger structure: the Milky Way or the Solar System?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Which is the larger structure: the Milky Way or the Solar System? The Milky Way. The Milky Way contains the Sun and its Solar System along with many other stars and planetary systems. A galaxy is a much larger structure than one solar system.
